title: Korea Forecasts Autumn Leaves Like the Weather

slides.headline: Korea forecasts autumn leaves **like the weather.**
slides.note: Maps, dates and an official start line. People plan their weekends around it.

slides.headline: Leaf season **comes with a map**
slides.body: Every fall, forecasters publish when danpung (단풍), autumn foliage, should reach each famous mountain, week by week. The news tracks it daily.

slides.headline: There's an **official first day**
slides.body: When the top fifth of a mountain turns, forecasters declare "first foliage." Seoraksan usually goes first, around late September.

slides.headline: Then the red **moves south**
slides.body: From Seoraksan in the northeast, the color line slides down the peninsula. Down south, Naejangsan peaks in early November.

slides.headline: That's **peak foliage**
slides.body: Once 80% of a mountain has turned, it's officially at its best. That's the weekend the trails fill up.

slides.headline: A mountain country, **a short window**
slides.body: About 70% of Korea is mountains, and peak color lasts only a week or two. Miss it, and you wait a year.

slides.headline: You wing it. **Koreans check the forecast.**
slides.body: Elsewhere, leaf-peeping is a whim. In Korea, it's a date on the calendar, often with a tour bus and a hiking club.

slides.headline: Spring **gets one too**
slides.body: Cherry blossoms have their own forecast every March. Korea tracks its seasons like a train timetable.

slides.headline: Even autumn **runs on a schedule**
slides.body: The leaves turn when they turn. But in Korea, everyone already knows the date.

slides.headline: Korea, explained **by a Korean.**
slides.body: Follow for the context behind the things Korea does.

caption:
Korea forecasts autumn leaves like the weather, with maps, dates and an official start line for each mountain.

First foliage is declared when the top fifth of a mountain turns, peak comes at 80%, and the color moves south from Seoraksan to Naejangsan over about a month.

When do people where you live go out to watch the seasons change?
reply: On peak weekends at Seoraksan, the trail to the top can turn into one long single-file line, so many hikers leave Seoul before dawn to beat the crowds. Tour buses run special leaf-season routes from the city. What's the one season people in your country plan their weekends around?
fact_check: 3·5장 기준: 기상청 정의, 산 정상부터 약 20%가 물들면 '첫 단풍', 산 전체의 약 80%가 물들면 '절정'. 'top fifth'는 20%를 풀어 쓴 표현.
2장 '예보': 기상청은 단풍 '예보'를 중단하고 관측만 하며, 예상 시기 지도는 민간 기상업체(웨더아이·케이웨더 등)가 냄. 그래서 'forecasters'로만 씀.
3장 설악산 첫 단풍 평년 9월 말(대략 9/26~29). 4장 내장산 절정 평년 11월 초.
6장 '약 70% 산지': 국토의 약 63~70%로 자료마다 다름. 'About 70%'. 절정 1~2주는 일반적 서술.
8장 벚꽃 개화 예보: 민간 기상업체가 2~3월에 발표. 'every March'는 대략적 표현.
댓글: 설악산 정상 등산로 정체·새벽 출발은 언론에 자주 나오는 장면. 단풍 관광버스 상품 존재.
